shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- routing toast ---\\n' && rg -n -C 3 \"toast|button\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- setup routing ---\\n' && sed -n '1,130p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- toast docs ---'; rg -n -C 8 \"Toast\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- toast declaration ---'; rg -n -C 8 \"export .*Toast|function Toast|const Toast\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/types 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- button docs refs ---'; rg -n \"view=|size=\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components 2>/dev/null | rg -i button | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Toaster/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- Toaster declarations ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts && printf '\\n--- Toaster source setup ---\\n' && rg -n -C 5 \"Toaster|Toast\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Toaster/ToasterProvider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Toaster/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/index.d.ts | sed -n '1,220p' && printf '\\n--- package docs files ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -iname '*toast*' -o -iname '*button*' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts && printf '\\n--- Provider ---\\n' && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts && printf '\\n--- package exports ---\\n' && rg -n \"ToasterComponent|ToasterProvider|toaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/index.js | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- Button decl ---\\n' && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Button/Button.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n'; rg -n \"Toast|Button\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/types/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -type d -name dist -o -name docs | sort"
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v apply_patch || true; find / -type f -name apply_patch -perm -111 2>/dev/null | head -20; git status --short'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/App.tsx')
text = path.read_text()
text = text.replace(\"import { Button, ToasterComponent, ToasterProvider, toaster } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\", \"import { Button, ToasterComponent, ToasterProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\\nimport { toaster } from '@gravity-ui/uikit/toaster-singleton';\")
text = text.replace('view=\"accent\"', 'view=\"action\"')
path.write_text(text)
PY
npm run build"
